name: text-reveal
title: Text reveal
description: Readable word, grapheme, phrase or measured-line arrivals with soft focus, fold and organic scale choices.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change this value to deliberately replay the reveal.

props.name: split
props.description: Lines use the browser's actual wrapping; graphemes keep emoji and marks intact.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between units. The total delay is capped for long text.
